title: How We Built Our Own Website with AI Agents and Full Transparency
excerpt: webvise.io is not a template or a marketing facade. It is a production Next.js application built entirely through AI-powered development, with self-hosted agent orchestration generating content, a Gemini-powered chatbot handling visitor questions, and every page available in 7 languages.
challenge: When you spend all your time building client websites, your own site is the last thing that gets attention. webvise needed a website that practices what it preaches, but the team was constantly occupied with client delivery. The solution had to be self-sustaining: a production application that generates its own blog content, translates itself into 7 languages, and converts visitors through an intelligent chatbot, all without pulling focus from client work. It also had to serve as a living proof of concept for the AI-first workflow webvise offers to clients.
solution: The entire site is developed through Claude Code with no traditional IDE. A self-hosted Paperclip AI instance orchestrates teams of Claude agents that research topics, write blog articles, and generate content across the pipeline. The AI chatbot, powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash via the Vercel AI SDK, handles visitor questions in real time and can analyze URLs shared in conversation. All content exists in 7 languages, maintained as structured JSON with AI-assisted translation. The result is a site where every component, from the 52+ blog articles to the case studies to the multilingual legal pages, flows through an automated, AI-driven content pipeline.
